purpose: Pre-registered prospective out-of-sample (OOS) evaluation ledger for Economy Aggregator liquidity indicators. Freezes rule forms, quantile estimation scheme, and global Holm-Bonferroni family BEFORE unseen future weekly observations arrive.

frozen_tests.hypothesis: During weeks with SPY weekly return <= -2.0%, BIL exact share-creation flow is higher than during non-crash weeks.
During weeks with SPY weekly return <= -2.0%, JNK exact share-creation flow is more negative than during non-crash weeks.
During weeks with BTCUSDT weekly return <= -5.0%, US BTC Spot ETF USD net flow is lower than during non-crash weeks.
During weeks with BTCUSDT weekly return <= -5.0%, weekly change in BTC Futures OI is more negative than during non-crash weeks.
Joint rule (BIL_flow > expanding Q80 AND GLD_flow < expanding Q20) yields prospective Lift > 1.0x for same-week SPY <= -2.0%.
frozen_tests.null_rejection_criterion: Lower bound of 95% bootstrap CI for Lift > 1.0x and Holm p < 0.05

frozen_tests.hypothesis: Continuous ^MOVE weekly level remains positively associated with BIL exact flow after controlling for SOFR level, delta-SOFR, and Year FE (Newey-West HAC lag=4).
frozen_tests.null_rejection_criterion: HAC two-sided Holm p < 0.05 and positive slope

frozen_tests.hypothesis: Strict non-overlapping 2-week future WRMFNS change positively responds to BIL_t after controlling for MMF_t, SOFR_t, and SPY_ret_t (HAC lag=2).
frozen_tests.null_rejection_criterion: HAC two-sided Holm p < 0.05 (currently NOT supported in 2018-2026 regression; tracked as falsification check)

frozen_tests.hypothesis: Default ex-RRP 8-variable VAR(2) H=10 spillover (fed_walcl_minus_tga, avoiding RRP<->MMF overlap) remains statistically above 1,000-permutation null (z > 2.0, p < 0.05) on active post-2022 regime.

explicitly_excluded_unsupported_rules: JNK outflow during calm SPY weeks (|r|<=1%) as early warning for future 1w/4w SPY crash (unsupported / low power in historical pseudo-OOS).
JNK>0 & BIL<=0 during SPY rebound weeks as predictor of 4-week rally continuation (unsupported, Lift ~0.97x in historical pseudo-OOS).
Standalone GLD weekly flow as crash stress indicator (fails Holm-Bonferroni).
Total stablecoin market cap delta as discriminator between internal exchange BTC->USDT swap parking vs idle capital (unidentified without exchange stablecoin reserves).
